Openweight.fact: The Nanatei Jūdō (ja:七帝柔道, Seven Emperors Judo) tournament has been held annually since 1952.

Openweight.subject: International Relations
Openweight.question: Daniel Mendoza was a boxer famous in the 1780s and 90s for regularly fighting and beating taller and heavier challengers before being decisively beaten by John Jackson, who was _____ taller and 42 lbs
Openweight.fact: Daniel Mendoza was a boxer famous in the 1780s and 90s for regularly fighting and beating taller and heavier challengers before being decisively beaten by John Jackson, who was 4 inches taller and 42 lbs heavier than Mendoza.

Openweight.subject: International Relations
Openweight.question: PRIDE did again an open-weight tournament in 2006 with the Pride FC: _____ 2006 which was divided in three separate events instead
Openweight.fact: Not all open-weight fights were "freak shows" however, PRIDE Fighting Championships organized in 2000 a two-night 16-fighter "Grand Prix" (tournament) called the Pride FC: Grand Prix 2000 with the objective of finding "the world's best fighter" and consisted with the top fighters at the time, from 75.75kg (167 lb) Kazushi Sakuraba to 116 kg (255 lb) Mark Kerr. PRIDE did again an open-weight tournament in 2006 with the Pride FC: Grand Prix 2006 which was divided in three separate events instead.

Openweight.subject: International Relations
Openweight.question: The openweight division in mixed martial arts (MMA) generally groups fighters above 265 lb (_____)
Openweight.fact: The openweight division in mixed martial arts (MMA) generally groups fighters above 265 lb (120.2 kg).

Openweight.question: Deep currently has an openweight division called "Megaton" although the first champion was Yusuke Kawaguchi, who weighed less than _____
Openweight.fact: Deep currently has an openweight division called "Megaton" although the first champion was Yusuke Kawaguchi, who weighed less than 100 kg.
